title: North Platte Canteen Congressional Gold Medal Act
short_title: North Platte Canteen Congressional Gold Medal Act
committees: S-Banking, Housing, and Urban Affairs Committee: Referred To 2025-02-20 -> Referred To 2025-02-20 -> Discharged From 2026-06-08
summary: North Platte Canteen Congressional Gold Medal Act This bill provides for the award of a Congressional Gold Medal to recognize the individuals and communities that provided financial and other support for the North Platte Canteen in North Platte, Nebraska, during World War II.

journey.note: Passed the Senate; waiting on the House
